title: Cambridge IELTS 19 Test 2 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The plans below show a harbour in 2000 and how it looks today.
scenario: The plans compare Porth Harbour in 2000 with Porth Harbour today.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: Porth Harbour
notes: Both plans show the harbour, surrounding land and facilities.
In 2000, the marina for private yachts is in the north-west harbour area and the fishing boats are in the south-west harbour area; today these uses are reversed.
A second showers and toilets facility appears beside the southern car park today.
Cafés and shops appear beside the road today.
An additional dock appears in the harbour today.
The disused castle is replaced by a hotel.
The southern public beach becomes a private beach for the hotel.
The northern public beach, passenger ferries, lifeboat, main road, road and two car parks remain shown.
